294: 		case <-ticker.C:

304: 	m.mu.Lock()

306: 
307: 	if !m.running || m.cmd == nil || m.cmd.Process == nil {
308: 		return nil
309: 	}
310: 
311: 	m.logger.Info("Stopping KNIRVHASHER")
312: 
313: 	if err := m.cmd.Process.Signal(syscall.SIGTERM); err != nil {
314: 		m.logger.Warn("Failed to send SIGTERM, forcing kill",
315: 			zap.Error(err))
316: 		syscall.Kill(-m.cmd.Process.Pid, syscall.SIGKILL)
317: 	}
318: 
319: 	done := make(chan error, 1)
320: 	go func() {
321: 		done <- m.cmd.Wait()
322: 	}()
323: 
324: 	select {
325: 	case err := <-done:
326: 		m.running = false
327: 		m.startTime = time.Time{}
328: 		if err != nil {
329: 			m.logger.Info("KNIRVHASHER stopped", zap.Error(err))
330: 		} else {
331: 			m.logger.Info("KNIRVHASHER stopped gracefully")
332: 		}
333: 		return nil
334: 	case <-time.After(m.config.StopTimeout):
335: 		m.logger.Warn("Timeout waiting for graceful shutdown, forcing kill")
336: 		syscall.Kill(-m.cmd.Process.Pid, syscall.SIGKILL)
337: 		select {
338: 		case <-done:
339: 		case <-time.After(2 * time.Second):
340: 			m.logger.Warn("Wait() did not complete after Kill() — zombie possible")
341: 		}
342: 		m.running = false
343: 		m.startTime = time.Time{}
344: 		return fmt.Errorf("forced shutdown after timeout")
345: 	}

138: func (c *Controller) StartDriver(ctx context.Context) error {
139: 	if port := findRunningHasherHost(); port > 0 {
140: 		c.model.ServerReady = true
141: 		c.model.ServerStarting = false
142: 		c.apiClient = client.NewAPIClient(port)
143: 		return nil
144: 	}
145: 
146: 	hostPath, err := embedded.GetHasherHostPathForce()
147: 	if err != nil {
148: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to extract hasher-host: %w", err)
149: 	}
150: 
151: 	binDir, err := embedded.GetBinDir()
152: 	if err != nil {
153: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get binary directory: %w", err)
154: 	}
155: 
156: 	var args []string
157: 	deviceConfig, _ := config.LoadDeviceConfig()
158: 	if deviceConfig != nil && deviceConfig.IP != "" {
159: 		args = append(args, "--device="+deviceConfig.IP)
160: 		args = append(args, "--discover=false")
161: 		args = append(args, "--force-redeploy=true")
162: 		if deviceConfig.Password != "" {
163: 			args = append(args, "--server-ssh-password="+deviceConfig.Password)
164: 		}
165: 	} else {
166: 		args = append(args, "--discover=true")
167: 		args = append(args, "--auto-deploy=true")
168: 	}
169: 
170: 	if deviceConfig != nil && deviceConfig.FramesDir != "" {
171: 		args = append(args, "--frames-dir="+deviceConfig.FramesDir)
172: 	}
173: 
174: 	if deviceConfig != nil && deviceConfig.CGMinerHost != "" {
175: 		args = append(args, "--cgminer-host="+deviceConfig.CGMinerHost)
176: 	}
177: 
178: 	cmd := exec.Command(hostPath, args...)
179: 	cmd.Dir = binDir
180: 	cmd.Env = os.Environ()
181: 	if deviceConfig != nil {
182: 		if deviceConfig.IP != "" {
183: 			cmd.Env = append(cmd.Env, "DEVICE_IP="+deviceConfig.IP)
184: 		}
185: 		if deviceConfig.Password != "" {
186: 			cmd.Env = append(cmd.Env, "DEVICE_PASSWORD="+deviceConfig.Password)
187: 		}
188: 		if deviceConfig.Username != "" {
189: 			cmd.Env = append(cmd.Env, "DEVICE_USERNAME="+deviceConfig.Username)
190: 		}
191: 	}
192: 
193: 	stdoutPipe, err := cmd.StdoutPipe()
194: 	if err != nil {
195: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create stdout pipe: %w", err)
196: 	}
197: 	stderrPipe, err := cmd.StderrPipe()
198: 	if err != nil {
199: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create stderr pipe: %w", err)
200: 	}
201: 
202: 	if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
203: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to start hasher-host: %w", err)
204: 	}
205: 
206: 	c.serverCmd = cmd
207: 	c.model.ServerCmd = cmd
208: 	c.model.ServerStarting = true
209: 
210: 	go c.streamOutput(stdoutPipe, stderrPipe)
211: 	go c.waitForServerReady()
212: 
213: 	return nil
214: }

216: func (c *Controller) streamOutput(stdout, stderr io.ReadCloser) {
217: 	go func() {
218: 		defer stdout.Close()
219: 		buf := make([]byte, 1024)
220: 		for {
221: 			n, err := stdout.Read(buf)
222: 			if err != nil {
223: 				return
224: 			}
225: 			if n > 0 {
226: 				select {
227: 				case c.logChan <- string(buf[:n]):
228: 				default:
229: 				}
230: 			}
231: 		}
232: 	}()
233: 
234: 	go func() {
235: 		defer stderr.Close()
236: 		buf := make([]byte, 1024)
237: 		for {
238: 			n, err := stderr.Read(buf)
239: 			if err != nil {
240: 				return
241: 			}
242: 			if n > 0 {
243: 				select {
244: 				case c.logChan <- string(buf[:n]):
245: 				default:
246: 				}
247: 			}
248: 		}
249: 	}()
250: }

252: func (c *Controller) waitForServerReady() {
253: 	startTime := time.Now()
254: 	timeout := 5 * time.Minute
255: 	portFile := "/tmp/hasher-host.port"
256: 
257: 	for time.Since(startTime) < timeout {
258: 		portBytes, err := os.ReadFile(portFile)
259: 		if err == nil {
260: 			port, err := strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimSpace(string(portBytes)))
261: 			if err == nil && isHasherHostRunning(port) {
262: 				c.model.ServerReady = true
263: 				c.model.ServerStarting = false
264: 				c.apiClient = client.NewAPIClient(port)
265: 				return
266: 			}
267: 		}
268: 		time.Sleep(500 * time.Millisecond)
269: 	}
270: }

431: func (c *Controller) ManageRules(ctx context.Context, action string, args ...string) (string, error) {
432: 	validator, err := validation.NewLogicalValidator()
433: 	if err != nil {
434: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("error creating validator: %w", err)
435: 	}
436: 
437: 	switch action {
438: 	case "list":
439: 		var output strings.Builder
440: 		output.WriteString("Logical Validation Rules\n")
441: 		output.WriteString("==========================\n\n")
442: 
443: 		if len(args) > 0 {
444: 			domain := args[0]
445: 			rules, err := validator.KnowledgeBase.GetRules(domain)
446: 			if err != nil {
447: 				return "", err
448: 			}
449: 			output.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("Domain: %s (%d rules)\n\n", domain, len(rules)))
450: 			for i, rule := range rules {
451: 				output.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("[%d] %s\n", i, rule.String()))
452: 			}
453: 		} else {
454: 			for domain, rules := range validator.KnowledgeBase.Domains {
455: 				output.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("Domain: %s (%d rules)\n", domain, len(rules)))
456: 				for i, rule := range rules {
457: 					output.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("  [%d] %s\n", i, rule.String()))
458: 				}
459: 			}
460: 		}
461: 		return output.String(), nil
462: 
463: 	case "add":
464: 		if len(args) < 3 {
465: 			return "", fmt.Errorf("usage: add <domain> <type> <conclusion>")
466: 		}
467: 		domain := args[0]
468: 		ruleType := args[1]
469: 		conclusion := strings.Join(args[2:], " ")
470: 
471: 		rule, err := validation.NewLogicalRule(ruleType, []string{}, conclusion, "Added via API")
472: 		if err != nil {
473: 			return "", err
474: 		}
475: 
476: 		if err := validator.KnowledgeBase.AddRule(domain, rule); err != nil {
477: 			return "", err
478: 		}
479: 
480: 		return fmt.Sprintf("Rule added to domain '%s'", domain), nil
481: 
482: 	case "delete":
483: 		if len(args) < 2 {
484: 			return "", fmt.Errorf("usage: delete <domain> <index>")
485: 		}
486: 		domain := args[0]
487: 		var index int
488: 		fmt.Sscanf(args[1], "%d", &index)
489: 
490: 		if err := validator.KnowledgeBase.RemoveRule(domain, index); err != nil {
491: 			return "", err
492: 		}
493: 
494: 		return fmt.Sprintf("Rule %d deleted from domain '%s'", index, domain), nil
495: 
496: 	default:
497: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("unknown action: %s", action)
498: 	}
499: }

515: func (c *Controller) RunPipeline(ctx context.Context, pipelineType string) error {
516: 	binDir, err := embedded.GetBinDir()
517: 	if err != nil {
518: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get binary directory: %w", err)
519: 	}
520: 
521: 	// When the CLI was started with -goat, enforce goat mode regardless of
522: 	// the pipeline type sent over HTTP, so the flag always reaches data-miner.
523: 	if c.goatMode && pipelineType != "arxiv" && pipelineType != "demo" {
524: 		pipelineType = "goat"
525: 	}
526: 
527: 	stages := buildPipelineStages(pipelineType)
528: 
529: 	c.model.PipelineRunning = true
530: 	c.model.PipelineStage = "initializing"
531: 	c.model.PipelineStages = stages
532: 	c.model.PipelineType = pipelineType
533: 
534: 	for i, stage := range stages {
535: 		c.model.PipelineStage = stage.Name
536: 
537: 		binaryPath := filepath.Join(binDir, stage.BinName)
538: 
539: 		if _, err := os.Stat(binaryPath); err != nil {
540: 			binaryPath, err = embedded.GetBinaryPath(stage.BinName)
541: 			if err != nil {
542: 				c.model.PipelineRunning = false
543: 				return fmt.Errorf("binary not found: %s (%w)", stage.BinName, err)
544: 			}
545: 		}
546: 
547: 		var cmd *exec.Cmd
548: 		if len(stage.Args) > 0 {
549: 			cmd = exec.Command(binaryPath, stage.Args...)
550: 		} else {
551: 			cmd = exec.Command(binaryPath)
552: 		}
553: 		cmd.Dir = binDir
554: 
555: 		if stage.BinName == "data-miner" || stage.BinName == "data-trainer" {
556: 			// Ensure spaCy shared lib and Python packages are findable.
557: 			// Filter out any inherited PYTHONPATH/LD_LIBRARY_PATH first so our
558: 			// values are not shadowed by duplicates when glibc does the lookup.
559: 			existingPyPath := os.Getenv("PYTHONPATH")
560: 			pyPath := pythonSitePackages()
561: 			if existingPyPath != "" {
562: 				pyPath = pyPath + ":" + existingPyPath
563: 			}
564: 			existingLd := os.Getenv("LD_LIBRARY_PATH")
565: 			ldPath := binDir
566: 			if existingLd != "" {
567: 				ldPath += ":" + existingLd
568: 			}
569: 			baseEnv := filterEnv(os.Environ(), "PYTHONPATH", "LD_LIBRARY_PATH")
570: 			cmd.Env = append(baseEnv,
571: 				"LD_LIBRARY_PATH="+ldPath,
572: 				"PYTHONPATH="+pyPath,
573: 			)
574: 		}
575: 
576: 		stdout, err := cmd.StdoutPipe()
577: 		if err != nil {
578: 			return fmt.Errorf("failed to create stdout pipe: %w", err)
579: 		}
580: 		stderr, err := cmd.StderrPipe()
581: 		if err != nil {
582: 			return fmt.Errorf("failed to create stderr pipe: %w", err)
583: 		}
584: 
585: 		if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
586: 			c.model.PipelineRunning = false
587: 			return fmt.Errorf("failed to start %s: %w", stage.Name, err)
588: 		}
589: 
590: 		c.pipelineState.Mu.Lock()
591: 		c.pipelineState.Cmd = cmd
592: 		c.pipelineState.Running = true
593: 		c.pipelineState.Mu.Unlock()
594: 
595: 		go c.streamPipelineOutput(cmd, stdout, stderr, i, stage)
596: 
597: 		err = cmd.Wait()
598: 		c.pipelineState.Mu.Lock()
599: 		c.pipelineState.Running = false
600: 		c.pipelineState.Mu.Unlock()
601: 
602: 		if err != nil {
603: 			c.model.PipelineRunning = false
604: 			return fmt.Errorf("%s failed: %w", stage.Name, err)
605: 		}
606: 	}
607: 
608: 	c.model.PipelineRunning = false
609: 	c.model.PipelineStage = "complete"
610: 	return nil
611: }

613: func (c *Controller) streamPipelineOutput(cmd *exec.Cmd, stdout, stderr io.ReadCloser, stageIndex int, stage PipelineStage) {
614: 	go func() {
615: 		defer stdout.Close()
616: 		scanner := bufio.NewScanner(stdout)
617: 		for scanner.Scan() {
618: 			line := strings.TrimSpace(scanner.Text())
619: 			if line != "" {
620: 				if len(line) > 150 {
621: 					line = line[:147] + "..."
622: 				}
623: 				prefixed := fmt.Sprintf("[%s] [%s] %s", time.Now().Format("15:04:05"), stage.Name, line)
624: 				// Emit to the parent process stdout so backend_server's SubprocessWriter captures it
625: 				fmt.Fprintln(os.Stdout, prefixed)
626: 				logMsg := fmt.Sprintf("[%s] %s", time.Now().Format("15:04:05"), line)
627: 				c.pipelineLogChan <- PipelineLogMsg{
628: 					Log:        logMsg,
629: 					StageIndex: stageIndex,
630: 					Stage:      stage.Name,
631: 				}
632: 			}
633: 		}
634: 	}()
635: 
636: 	go func() {
637: 		defer stderr.Close()
638: 		scanner := bufio.NewScanner(stderr)
639: 		for scanner.Scan() {
640: 			line := strings.TrimSpace(scanner.Text())
641: 			if line != "" {
642: 				if len(line) > 150 {
643: 					line = line[:147] + "..."
644: 				}
645: 				prefixed := fmt.Sprintf("[%s] [%s] [stderr] %s", time.Now().Format("15:04:05"), stage.Name, line)
646: 				// Emit to the parent process stderr so backend_server's SubprocessWriter captures it
647: 				fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, prefixed)
648: 				logMsg := fmt.Sprintf("[%s] [stderr] %s", time.Now().Format("15:04:05"), line)
649: 				c.pipelineLogChan <- PipelineLogMsg{
650: 					Log:        logMsg,
651: 					StageIndex: stageIndex,
652: 					Stage:      stage.Name,
653: 				}
654: 			}
655: 		}
656: 	}()
657: }

51: // DiscoverServers scans the network for hasher-server instances
52: func DiscoverServers(config DiscoveryConfig) ([]DiscoveryResult, error) {
53: 	// Get local network to scan if subnet not specified
54: 	if config.Subnet == "" {
55: 		subnet, err := getLocalSubnet()

65: 	}

68: 	semaphore := make(chan struct{}, config.ConcurrentScans)

148: 	}

157: 	if err != nil {

159: 		result.LatencyMs = time.Since(start).Milliseconds()
160: 		return result

164: 	result.ChipCount = int(info.ChipCount)
165: 	result.Version = info.FirmwareVersion
166: 	result.LatencyMs = time.Since(start).Milliseconds()

171: // getLocalSubnet attempts to determine the local network subnet
172: func getLocalSubnet() (string, error) {
173: 	// Get all network interfaces
174: 	interfaces, err := net.Interfaces()
175: 	if err != nil {
176: 		return "", err
177: 	}
178: 
179: 	// Look for IPv4 interfaces that are up and not loopback
180: 	for _, iface := range interfaces {
181: 		if iface.Flags&net.FlagUp == 0 || iface.Flags&net.FlagLoopback != 0 {
182: 			continue
183: 		}
184: 
185: 		addrs, err := iface.Addrs()
186: 		if err != nil {
187: 			continue
188: 		}
189: 
190: 		for _, addr := range addrs {
191: 			var ip net.IP
192: 			switch v := addr.(type) {
193: 			case *net.IPNet:
194: 				ip = v.IP
195: 			case *net.IPAddr:
196: 				ip = v.IP
197: 			}
198: 
199: 			if ip == nil || ip.To4() == nil {
200: 				continue
201: 			}
202: 
203: 			// Convert to subnet (assume /24 for home networks)
204: 			parts := strings.Split(ip.String(), ".")
205: 			if len(parts) == 4 {
206: 				return fmt.Sprintf("%s.%s.%s.0/24", parts[0], parts[1], parts[2]), nil
207: 			}
208: 		}
209: 	}
210: 
211: 	return "", fmt.Errorf("no suitable network interface found")
212: }

227: 	if ip == nil {
228: 		return false
229: 	}
230: 
231: 	// Check if it's loopback
232: 	if ip.IsLoopback() {
233: 		return true
234: 	}
235: 
236: 	// Get local interfaces and check if any match
237: 	interfaces, err := net.Interfaces()
238: 	if err != nil {
239: 		return false
240: 	}
241: 
242: 	for _, iface := range interfaces {
243: 		addrs, err := iface.Addrs()
244: 		if err != nil {
245: 			continue
246: 		}
247: 
248: 		for _, addr := range addrs {
249: 			var ifaceIP net.IP
250: 			switch v := addr.(type) {
251: 			case *net.IPNet:
252: 				ifaceIP = v.IP
253: 			case *net.IPAddr:
254: 				ifaceIP = v.IP
255: 			}
256: 
257: 			if ifaceIP != nil && ifaceIP.Equal(ip) {
258: 				return true
259: 			}
260: 		}
261: 	}
262: 
263: 	return false
264: }

266: // FindBestServer selects the best hasher-server from discovered results
267: func FindBestServer(discoveries []DiscoveryResult) *DiscoveryResult {
268: 	var best *DiscoveryResult
269: 
270: 	for i := range discoveries {
271: 		result := &discoveries[i]
272: 
273: 		// Skip non-responding servers
274: 		if !result.Responding {
275: 			continue
276: 		}
277: 
278: 		// First responding server wins, or prefer one with more chips
279: 		if best == nil || result.ChipCount > best.ChipCount ||
280: 			(result.ChipCount == best.ChipCount && result.LatencyMs < best.LatencyMs) {
281: 			best = result
282: 		}
283: 	}
284: 
285: 	return best
286: }

288: // DiscoverAndConnect scans network and connects to the best available server
289: func DiscoverAndConnect(config DiscoveryConfig) (*asic.ASICClient, *DiscoveryResult, error) {
290: 	discoveries, err := DiscoverServers(config)
291: 	if err != nil {
292: 		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("network discovery failed: %w", err)
293: 	}
294: 
295: 	best := FindBestServer(discoveries)
296: 	if best == nil {
297: 		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("no hasher-server instances found on network")
298: 	}
299: 
300: 	// Connect to the best server
301: 	client, err := asic.NewASICClient(best.Address)
302: 	if err != nil {
303: 		return nil, best, fmt.Errorf("failed to connect to best server %s: %w", best.Address, err)
304: 	}
305: 
306: 	// Verify the client actually connected to real hardware, not software fallback
307: 	if client.IsUsingFallback() {
308: 		client.Close()
309: 		return nil, best, fmt.Errorf("connected to %s but server is in fallback mode (ASIC not operational)", best.Address)
310: 	}
311: 
312: 	return client, best, nil
313: }

417: 				SkipLocalhost: false,
418: 			}
419: 			if *discoverySubnet != "" {
420: 				config.Subnet = *discoverySubnet
421: 			}
422: 
423: 			var err error
424: 			asicClient, discoveryResult, err = discovery.DiscoverAndConnect(config)
425: 			if err != nil {
426: 				log.Printf("Warning: Localhost discovery failed: %v", err)
427: 				log.Printf("Creating ASIC client for direct connection attempt...")
428: 				var clientErr error
429: 				asicClient, clientErr = asic.NewASICClient("") // Create client for direct connection attempt
430: 				if clientErr != nil {
431: 					log.Printf("Warning: ASIC client creation failed: %v", clientErr)
432: 					asicClient = nil
433: 				}
434: 			} else {
435: 				log.Printf("Connected to discovered hasher-server at %s", discoveryResult.Address)
436: 				log.Printf("Server info: %d chips, %s, latency: %dms",
437: 					discoveryResult.ChipCount, discoveryResult.Version, discoveryResult.LatencyMs)
438: 				serverDeviceAddr = discoveryResult.Address
439: 			}
440: 		}
441: 	} else {
442: 		// Try localhost only
443: 		log.Printf("Trying localhost hasher-server...")
444: 		serverDeviceAddr = "localhost:8888"
445: 		var err error
446: 		asicClient, err = asic.NewASICClient("localhost:8888")
447: 		if err != nil {
448: 			log.Printf("Warning: Could not connect to localhost hasher-server: %v", err)
449: 			asicClient = nil
450: 		}
451: 	}
452: 
453: 	// Default to software fallback if no ASIC device is available or specified
454: 	if asicClient == nil {
455: 		log.Printf("No ASIC device available - enabling software fallback mode")
456: 		// Create a fallback ASIC client that will use software SHA-256
457: 		var clientErr error
458: 		asicClient, clientErr = asic.NewASICClient("")
459: 		if clientErr != nil {
460: 			log.Printf("Warning: Failed to create software fallback client: %v", clientErr)
461: 			asicClient = nil
462: 		} else {
463: 			log.Printf("Software fallback mode initialized successfully")
464: 		}
465: 	}
466: 
467: 	// Override with explicit flags if provided
468: 	if *serverDeviceIP != "" {
469: 		serverDeviceAddr = *serverDeviceIP
470: 	} else if *device != "" {
471: 		// Device flag takes precedence for IP extraction
472: 		serverDeviceAddr = *device
473: 	}
474: 
475: 	if asicClient != nil {
476: 		if asicClient.IsUsingFallback() {
477: 			log.Printf("Running in SOFTWARE FALLBACK mode (ASIC server not available)")
478: 		} else {
479: 			chipCount := asicClient.GetChipCount()
480: 			if discoveryResult != nil {
481: 				log.Printf("Connected to ASIC server with %d chips at %s", chipCount, discoveryResult.Address)
482: 			} else {
483: 				log.Printf("Connected to ASIC server with %d chips", chipCount)
484: 			}
485: 		}
486: 	}
487: 
488: 	// Create hash network
489: 	network, err := neural.NewHashNetwork(*inputSize, *hidden1, *hidden2, *outputSize)
490: 	if err != nil {
491: 		log.Fatalf("Failed to create hash network: %v", err)
492: 	}
493: 	log.Printf("Hash network created: [%d, %d, %d, %d]", *inputSize, *hidden1, *hidden2, *outputSize)
494: 
495: 	// Create ASICMethod wrapper for HashMethod interface
496: 	var hashMethod *asic.ASICMethod
497: 	if asicClient != nil && !asicClient.IsUsingFallback() {
498: 		// Create ASICMethod from the server device address
499: 		address := serverDeviceAddr
500: 		if address == "" {
501: 			address = "localhost:8888"
502: 		}
503: 		hashMethod = asic.NewASICMethod(address)
504: 		if err := hashMethod.Initialize(); err != nil {
505: 			log.Printf("Warning: Failed to initialize ASICMethod: %v", err)
506: 			hashMethod = nil
507: 		}
508: 	}
509: 
510: 	// Create recursive engine with ASIC support
511: 	engine, err := inference.NewRecursiveEngineWithHashMethod(network, hashMethod, *passes, *jitter, *seedRotation)
512: 	if err != nil {
513: 		log.Fatalf("Failed to create recursive engine: %v", err)
514: 	}
515: 	log.Printf("Recursive engine created: %d passes, jitter=%.3f, seed_rotation=%v", *passes, *jitter, *seedRotation)
516: 
517: 	// Create crypto-transformer if enabled
518: 	var cryptoModel *transformer.HasherTransformer
519: 	var miningNeuron *neural.MiningNeuron
520: 	if *enableCrypto {
521: 		log.Printf("Initializing crypto-transformer...")
522: 		transformerConfig := &transformer.HasherTransformerConfig{
523: 			VocabSize:    *vocabSize,
524: 			EmbedDim:     *embedDim,
525: 			NumLayers:    *numLayers,
526: 			NumHeads:     *numHeads,
527: 			ContextLen:   128,
528: 			DropoutRate:  0.1,
529: 			FFNHiddenDim: *ffnHiddenDim,
530: 			Activation:   *cryptoActivation,
531: 		}
532: 		cryptoModel = transformer.NewHasherTransformer(transformerConfig, hashMethod)
533: 		log.Printf("Crypto-transformer created: vocab=%d, embed=%d, layers=%d, heads=%d",
534: 			*vocabSize, *embedDim, *numLayers, *numHeads)
535: 
536: 		// Initialize MiningNeuron for converting transformer output to nonces
537: 		// Use much smaller nonce range for software fallback to avoid long delays
538: 		nonceEnd := uint32(1000000) // Large range for ASIC mode
539: 		if asicClient != nil && asicClient.IsUsingFallback() {
540: 			nonceEnd = 1 // Single nonce for software fallback (instant)
541: 		}
542: 
543: 		miningNeuronConfig := neural.MiningNeuronConfig{
544: 			InputDim:   *vocabSize, // Input to MiningNeuron is the tokenScores (logits)
545: 			OutputDim:  8,          // Generate 8 projections for the mining header
546: 			Salt:       0xDEADBEEF, // Fixed salt for now
547: 			NonceStart: 0,
548: 			NonceEnd:   nonceEnd, // Dynamic search range based on hardware mode
549: 		}
550: 		miningNeuron = neural.NewMiningNeuron(miningNeuronConfig)
551: 		if hashMethod != nil {
552: 			miningNeuron.SetHashMethod(hashMethod)
553: 		}
554: 		log.Printf("MiningNeuron created with InputDim=%d, OutputDim=%d", miningNeuronConfig.InputDim, miningNeuronConfig.OutputDim)
555: 	}
556: 
557: 	// Initialize JitterEngine — the core inference engine for the 21-pass temporal loop.
558: 	// This is the "brain" of the model: it navigates the 12-slot Semantic Maze using
559: 	// SHA-256 hashing to produce a Golden Nonce that IS the next token address.
560: 	// Software mode uses pure-Go SHA-256 (identical logic to the ASIC hardware path).
561: 	jitterCfg := jitterpkg.DefaultJitterConfig()
562: 	jitterCfg.Verbose = false
563: 	inferenceJitterEngine := jitterpkg.NewJitterEngine(jitterCfg)
564: 	log.Printf("JitterEngine initialized: %d-pass temporal loop (software SHA-256)", jitterCfg.PassCount)
565: 
566: 	// Load training frames into the FlashSearcher knowledge base.
567: 	// This enables the 3-zone associative lookup and Reverse Lookup (golden nonce → token).
568: 	actualFramesDir := *framesDir
569: 	if actualFramesDir == "" {
570: 		// Try default location
571: 		homeDir, _ := os.UserHomeDir()
572: 		if homeDir != "" {
573: 			defaultFramesDir := filepath.Join(homeDir, ".local", "share", "hasher", "data", "frames")
574: 			if _, err := os.Stat(defaultFramesDir); err == nil {
575: 				actualFramesDir = defaultFramesDir
576: 			}
577: 		}
578: 	}
579: 
580: 	if actualFramesDir != "" {
581: 		n, err := jitterpkg.LoadFromDirectory(inferenceJitterEngine.GetSearcher(), actualFramesDir)
582: 		if err != nil {
583: 			log.Printf("Warning: knowledge base load error: %v", err)
584: 		} else {
585: 			log.Printf("Knowledge base: loaded %d training frames from %s", n, actualFramesDir)
586: 		}
587: 	} else {
588: 		log.Printf("Knowledge base: no --frames-dir specified or found; FlashSearcher starts empty")
589: 	}
590: 
591: 	// Connect to the CGMiner API for ASIC-backed final nonce mining.
592: 	// When available, the ASIC mines the semantically refined header at ~500 GH/s,
593: 	// making the golden nonce a genuine hardware output rather than a software hash.
594: 	var cgminerMethod *devicepkg.CGMinerHashMethod
595: 	if *cgminerHost != "" {
596: 		var cgminerErr error
597: 		cgminerMethod, cgminerErr = devicepkg.NewCGMinerHashMethod(*cgminerHost, *cgminerPort, *cgminerTimeout)
598: 		if cgminerErr != nil {
599: 			log.Printf("Warning: CGMiner unavailable at %s:%d: %v — using software golden nonce", *cgminerHost, *cgminerPort, cgminerErr)
600: 			cgminerMethod = nil
601: 		} else {
602: 			log.Printf("CGMiner connected at %s:%d — ASIC will mine the final golden nonce", *cgminerHost, *cgminerPort)
603: 		}
604: 	}
605: 
606: 	// Create orchestrator
607: 	orch := &Orchestrator{
608: 		asicClient:         asicClient,
609: 		engine:             engine,
610: 		network:            network,
611: 		cryptoModel:        cryptoModel,
612: 		miningNeuron:       miningNeuron,
613: 		jitterEngine:       inferenceJitterEngine,
614: 		cgminerMethod:      cgminerMethod,
615: 		discoveryResult:    discoveryResult,
616: 		startTime:          time.Now(),
617: 		deployer:           deployer,
618: 		connectionHealthy:  asicClient != nil && !asicClient.IsUsingFallback(),
619: 		lastHealthCheck:    time.Now(),
620: 		stopMonitor:        make(chan struct{}),
621: 		stopLogMonitorChan: make(chan struct{}),
622: 		serverDeviceIPAddr: extractIPFromAddress(serverDeviceAddr),
623: 	}
624: 
625: 	// Load schema and activate domain-specific plugin if --schema is provided.
626: 	// The same binary becomes a General HASHER or a MATHASHER at runtime:
627: 	//   ./hasher-host --schema pipeline/2_DATA_ENCODER/config/prose_schema.yaml  → HASHER
628: 	//   ./hasher-host --schema pipeline/2_DATA_ENCODER/config/math_schema.yaml   → MATHASHER
629: 	if *schemaPath != "" {
630: 		if _, statErr := os.Stat(*schemaPath); statErr != nil {
631: 			log.Fatalf("Schema file not found: %s", *schemaPath)
632: 		}
633: 		domain, domErr := hashermath.LoadDomainFromSchema(*schemaPath)
634: 		if domErr != nil {
635: 			log.Fatalf("Failed to read schema domain from %s: %v", *schemaPath, domErr)
636: 		}
637: 		log.Printf("Schema loaded: domain=%s file=%s", domain, *schemaPath)
638: 
639: 		if domain == "MATHASHER" {
640: 			subdomainVal := uint32(*subdomain)
641: 			rules, rulesErr := hashermath.LoadWatchdogRulesFromYAML(*schemaPath)
642: 			if rulesErr != nil {
643: 				log.Printf("Warning: could not load watchdog rules from schema: %v — using hard-coded fallback", rulesErr)
644: 				orch.mathServer = hasherapi.NewMathVerifierServer(subdomainVal)
645: 			} else {
646: 				log.Printf("MATHASHER mode: loaded %d validation rules", len(rules))
647: 				orch.mathServer = hasherapi.NewMathVerifierServerWithRules(subdomainVal, rules)
648: 			}
649: 			log.Printf("MATHASHER routes will be available at POST /v1/verify/math and GET /v1/verify/math/health")
650: 		}
651: 	}
652: 
653: 	// Start connection monitor for ASIC connection health
654: 	if asicClient != nil && !asicClient.IsUsingFallback() {
655: 		go orch.runConnectionMonitor()
656: 	}
657: 
658: 	// Start server log monitoring if enabled and we have a server device IP
659: 	if *monitorServerLogs && orch.serverDeviceIPAddr != "" {
660: 		go orch.monitorServerLogs()
661: 	} else if *monitorServerLogs {
662: 		log.Printf("Warning: Server log monitoring enabled but no server device IP available")
663: 	}
664: 
665: 	// Find available port for API mode
666: 	var apiPort int
667: 	if *mode == "api" {
668: 		var err error
669: 		apiPort, err = findOpenPort(*port)
670: 		if err != nil {
671: 			log.Fatalf("Failed to find available port: %v", err)
672: 		}
673: 		// Update the port variable for the rest of the code
674: 		*port = apiPort
675: 
676: 		// Write port to file for CLI discovery
677: 		if err := writePortFile(apiPort); err != nil {
678: 			log.Printf("Warning: failed to write port file: %v", err)
679: 		}
680: 	}
681: 
682: 	// Run based on mode
683: 	switch *mode {
684: 	case "api":
685: 		if *enableAPI {
686: 			runAPIServer(orch)
687: 		} else {
688: 			log.Println("API server disabled by flag --api=false")
689: 			log.Println("Running in single mode instead")
690: 			runSingleMode(orch)
691: 		}
692: 	case "single":
693: 		runSingleMode(orch)
694: 	case "batch":
695: 		runBatchMode(orch)
696: 	case "stream":
697: 		runStreamMode(orch)
698: 	case "metrics":
699: 		showMetrics(orch)
700: 	case "info":
701: 		showInfo(orch)
702: 	default:
703: 		log.Fatalf("Unknown mode: %s", *mode)
704: 	}
705: }

707: // extractIPFromAddress extracts just the IP address from an address string (e.g., "192.168.1.1:8888" -> "192.168.1.1")
708: func extractIPFromAddress(addr string) string {
709: 	if addr == "" {
710: 		return ""
711: 	}
712: 	parts := strings.Split(addr, ":")
713: 	if len(parts) > 0 {
714: 		return parts[0]
715: 	}
716: 	return addr
717: }

719: // monitorServerLogs monitors the server logs via SSH and handles auto-reboot scenarios
720: func (o *Orchestrator) monitorServerLogs() {
721: 	log.Printf("Starting server log monitor for device %s", o.serverDeviceIPAddr)
722: 
723: 	ticker := time.NewTicker(5 * time.Second)
724: 	defer ticker.Stop()
725: 
726: 	for {
727: 		select {
728: 		case <-o.stopLogMonitorChan:
729: 			log.Printf("Server log monitor stopped")
730: 			return
731: 		case <-ticker.C:
732: 			if o.isRebooting {
733: 				// Skip monitoring while we're handling a reboot
734: 				continue
735: 			}
736: 
737: 			// Check for auto-reboot marker in server logs
738: 			if err := o.checkServerLogs(); err != nil {
739: 				// Only log errors occasionally to avoid spam
740: 				if o.reconnectAttempts%10 == 0 {
741: 					log.Printf("Warning: Failed to check server logs: %v", err)
742: 				}
743: 			}
744: 		}
745: 	}
746: }

748: // checkServerLogs checks the server logs via SSH for auto-reboot markers
749: func (o *Orchestrator) checkServerLogs() error {
750: 	// SSH into device and tail the log file for recent entries
751: 	sshCmd := fmt.Sprintf("sshpass -p '%s' ssh -o KexAlgorithms=+diffie-hellman-group14-sha1 -o HostKeyAlgorithms=+ssh-rsa -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=5 root@%s "+
752: 		"\"tail -n 50 %s 2>/dev/null || echo 'LOG_FILE_NOT_FOUND'\"",
753: 		*serverSSHPassword, o.serverDeviceIPAddr, *serverLogPath)
754: 
755: 	cmd := exec.Command("sh", "-c", sshCmd)
756: 	output, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
757: 	if err != nil {
758: 		return fmt.Errorf("ssh command failed: %v (output: %s)", err, string(output))
759: 	}
760: 
761: 	logOutput := string(output)
762: 
763: 	// Check for auto-reboot marker
764: 	if strings.Contains(logOutput, "AUTO_REBOOT_TRIGGERED") {
765: 		log.Printf("AUTO_REBOOT_TRIGGERED marker detected in server logs - server is rebooting")
766: 		go o.handleServerReboot()
767: 	}
768: 
769: 	return nil
770: }

772: // handleServerReboot handles the full server reboot recovery sequence
773: func (o *Orchestrator) handleServerReboot() {
774: 	o.mu.Lock()
775: 	if o.isRebooting {
776: 		o.mu.Unlock()
777: 		return // Already handling a reboot
778: 	}
779: 	o.isRebooting = true
780: 	o.mu.Unlock()
781: 
782: 	log.Printf("=== Starting server reboot recovery sequence ===")
783: 
784: 	// Step 1: Log that reboot is in progress
785: 	log.Printf("Server reboot in progress - waiting for connection to drop...")
786: 
787: 	// Step 2: Wait for connection to drop (indicating server is rebooting)
788: 	connectionDropped := o.waitForConnectionDrop(60 * time.Second)
789: 	if !connectionDropped {
790: 		log.Printf("Warning: Connection did not drop within timeout, assuming reboot is complete")
791: 	} else {
792: 		log.Printf("Connection dropped - server is rebooting")
793: 	}
794: 
795: 	// Step 3: Poll for server to come back online (retry every 5 seconds for up to 2 minutes)
796: 	log.Printf("Waiting for server to come back online...")
797: 	backOnline := o.pollForServerRecovery(120*time.Second, 5*time.Second)
798: 	if !backOnline {
799: 		log.Printf("ERROR: Server did not come back online within timeout - manual intervention required")
800: 		o.mu.Lock()
801: 		o.isRebooting = false
802: 		o.mu.Unlock()
803: 		return
804: 	}
805: 	log.Printf("Server is back online")
806: 
807: 	// Step 4: Download the server logs with timestamp
808: 	log.Printf("Downloading server logs...")
809: 	logFile, err := o.downloadServerLogs()
810: 	if err != nil {
811: 		log.Printf("Warning: Failed to download server logs: %v", err)
812: 	} else {
813: 		log.Printf("Server logs saved to: %s", logFile)
814: 	}
815: 
816: 	// Step 5: Cleanup old server process
817: 	log.Printf("Cleaning up old server process...")
818: 	if err := o.cleanupOldServerProcess(); err != nil {
819: 		log.Printf("Warning: Failed to cleanup old server process: %v", err)
820: 	}
821: 
822: 	// Step 6: Redeploy the server binary
823: 	log.Printf("Redeploying server binary...")
824: 	if err := o.redeployServerBinary(); err != nil {
825: 		log.Printf("ERROR: Failed to redeploy server binary: %v", err)
826: 		o.mu.Lock()
827: 		o.isRebooting = false
828: 		o.mu.Unlock()
829: 		return
830: 	}
831: 	log.Printf("Server binary redeployed successfully")
832: 
833: 	// Step 7: Restart the server
834: 	log.Printf("Restarting hasher-server...")
835: 	if err := o.restartServer(); err != nil {
836: 		log.Printf("ERROR: Failed to restart server: %v", err)
837: 		o.mu.Lock()
838: 		o.isRebooting = false
839: 		o.mu.Unlock()
840: 		return
841: 	}
842: 	log.Printf("Server restarted successfully")
843: 
844: 	// Step 8: Reconnect the ASIC client
845: 	log.Printf("Reconnecting ASIC client...")
846: 	if err := o.reconnectASICClient(); err != nil {
847: 		log.Printf("ERROR: Failed to reconnect ASIC client: %v", err)
848: 		o.mu.Lock()
849: 		o.isRebooting = false
850: 		o.mu.Unlock()
851: 		return
852: 	}
853: 	log.Printf("ASIC client reconnected successfully")
854: 
855: 	// Step 9: Resume normal operations
856: 	o.mu.Lock()
857: 	o.isRebooting = false
858: 	o.connectionHealthy = true
859: 	o.lastHealthCheck = time.Now()
860: 	o.reconnectAttempts = 0
861: 	o.mu.Unlock()
862: 
863: 	log.Printf("=== Server reboot recovery sequence complete - resuming normal operations ===")
864: }

866: // waitForConnectionDrop waits for the SSH connection to drop (indicating server reboot)
867: func (o *Orchestrator) waitForConnectionDrop(timeout time.Duration) bool {
868: 	deadline := time.Now().Add(timeout)
869: 	pollInterval := 1 * time.Second
870: 
871: 	for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
872: 		// Try to connect via SSH - if it fails, connection has dropped
873: 		sshCmd := fmt.Sprintf("sshpass -p '%s' ssh -o KexAlgorithms=+diffie-hellman-group14-sha1 -o HostKeyAlgorithms=+ssh-rsa -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=3 root@%s echo 'OK'",
874: 			*serverSSHPassword, o.serverDeviceIPAddr)
875: 		cmd := exec.Command("sh", "-c", sshCmd)
876: 		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
877: 			// Connection dropped
878: 			return true
879: 		}
880: 		time.Sleep(pollInterval)
881: 	}
882: 
883: 	return false // Timeout reached
884: }
885: 
886: // pollForServerRecovery polls for the server to come back online
887: func (o *Orchestrator) pollForServerRecovery(timeout time.Duration, interval time.Duration) bool {
888: 	deadline := time.Now().Add(timeout)
889: 
890: 	for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
891: 		// Try to SSH into the device
892: 		sshCmd := fmt.Sprintf("sshpass -p '%s' ssh -o KexAlgorithms=+diffie-hellman-group14-sha1 -o HostKeyAlgorithms=+ssh-rsa -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=5 root@%s echo 'READY'",
893: 			*serverSSHPassword, o.serverDeviceIPAddr)
894: 		cmd := exec.Command("sh", "-c", sshCmd)
895: 		if err := cmd.Run(); err == nil {
896: 			// Server is back online
897: 			return true
898: 		}
899: 
900: 		log.Printf("Waiting for server to come back online... (retry in %v)", interval)
901: 		time.Sleep(interval)
902: 	}
903: 
904: 	return false // Timeout reached
905: }

907: // downloadServerLogs downloads the server logs and saves them with a timestamp

909: 	// Create logs directory if it doesn't exist

911: 	if err := os.MkdirAll(logsDir, 0755); err != nil {
912: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to create logs directory: %w", err)
913: 	}
914: 
915: 	// Generate timestamped filename
916: 	timestamp := time.Now().Format("20060102_150405")
917: 	filename := fmt.Sprintf("hasher-server_%s_%s.log", o.serverDeviceIPAddr, timestamp)
918: 	filepath := filepath.Join(logsDir, filename)
919: 
920: 	// Download logs via SSH
921: 	sshCmd := fmt.Sprintf("sshpass -p '%s' ssh -o KexAlgorithms=+diffie-hellman-group14-sha1 -o HostKeyAlgorithms=+ssh-rsa -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=10 root@%s "+
922: 		"\"cat %s 2>/dev/null || echo 'LOG_FILE_NOT_FOUND'\"",
923: 		*serverSSHPassword, o.serverDeviceIPAddr, *serverLogPath)
924: 
925: 	cmd := exec.Command("sh", "-c", sshCmd)
926: 	output, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
927: 	if err != nil {
928: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("ssh command failed: %v (output: %s)", err, string(output))
929: 	}
930: 
931: 	// Write logs to file
932: 	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath, output, 0644); err != nil {
933: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to write log file: %w", err)

```go
func (m *Manager) Start(ctx context.Context) error {
    m.mu.Lock()
    defer m.mu.Unlock()

    if m.running {
        m.logger.Info("KNIRVHASHER already running")
        return nil
    }

    if m.config.BinaryPath == "" {
        m.config.BinaryPath = "./knirvhasher"
    }

    resolved, err := resolveBinaryPath(m.config.BinaryPath)
    if err != nil {
        return fmt.Errorf("KNIRVHASHER binary not found: %w", err)
    }
    m.config.BinaryPath = resolved

    hasherDir := filepath.Dir(m.socketPath)
    if hasherDir != "." && hasherDir != "/" {
        if err := os.MkdirAll(hasherDir, 0755); err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("failed to create socket directory: %w", err)
        }
    }

    if _, err := os.Stat(m.socketPath); err == nil {
        os.Remove(m.socketPath)
    }

    m.logger.Info("Starting KNIRVHASHER",
        zap.String("binary", m.config.BinaryPath),
        zap.String("socket", m.socketPath))

    // --- ENVIRONMENT VARIABLES ---
    env := os.Environ()
    env = append(env,
        fmt.Sprintf("HASHER_SOCKET_PATH=%s", m.socketPath),
        fmt.Sprintf("HASHER_DATA_PATH=%s", m.config.DataPath),
    )
    if m.config.GRPCSocketPath != "" {
        env = append(env, fmt.Sprintf("HASHER_GRPC_SOCKET_PATH=%s", m.config.GRPCSocketPath))
    }

    if appDataDir := os.Getenv("KNIRV_APP_DATA_DIR"); appDataDir != "" {
        env = append(env, fmt.Sprintf("KNIRV_APP_DATA_DIR=%s", appDataDir))
    } else if _, err := os.Stat("/var/lib/knirvserver"); err == nil {
        env = append(env, "KNIRV_APP_DATA_DIR=/var/lib/knirvserver")
    }

    if m.config.ArxivEnabled {
        env = append(env, "DATAMINER_MODE=production", "ARXIV_ENABLED=true")
    }

    // When running as root (e.g. via sudo), propagate the original user's Python
    // site-packages so the data-miner's embedded Python can find en_core_web_sm.
    if pyPath := sudoUserPythonPath(); pyPath != "" {
        env = append(env, "PYTHONPATH="+pyPath)
    }

    for k, v := range m.config.EnvOverrides {
        env = append(env, fmt.Sprintf("%s=%s", k, v))
    }

    // --- COMMAND LINE ARGUMENTS ---
    args := []string{}
    if m.config.HeadlessMode {
        socketPerm := fmt.Sprintf("%04o", m.config.SocketPerm)
        args = append(args,
            "--headless",
            fmt.Sprintf("--socket-path=%s", m.socketPath),
            fmt.Sprintf("--socket-perm=%s", socketPerm),
        )
    }
    // Default pipeline: MAPPER mode via Hugging Face API.
    // Data-connector (CONNECTION source) only runs after full user onboarding.
    if m.config.PipelineType == "goat" {
        args = append(args, "-goat")
    }

    m.cmd = exec.Command(m.config.BinaryPath, args...)
    m.cmd.Env = env
    if w, ok := m.config.Stdout.(io.Writer); ok {
        m.cmd.Stdout = w
    } else {
        m.cmd.Stdout = os.Stdout
    }
    if w, ok := m.config.Stderr.(io.Writer); ok {
        m.cmd.Stderr = w
    } else {
        m.cmd.Stderr = os.Stderr
    }
    m.cmd.SysProcAttr = &syscall.SysProcAttr{
        Setpgid: true,
    }

    if err := m.cmd.Start(); err != nil {
        return fmt.Errorf("failed to start KNIRVHASHER: %w", err)
    }
    m.startTime = time.Now()
    m.logger.Info("KNIRVHASHER subprocess started",
        zap.Int("pid", m.cmd.Process.Pid))

    if err := m.waitForSocket(ctx); err != nil {
        m.cmd.Process.Kill()
        return fmt.Errorf("socket creation failed: %w", err)
    }

    if m.config.HeadlessMode {
        m.logger.Info("KNIRVHASHER Unix socket ready")
        // Pipeline is NOT auto-started here.  The user triggers it via the
        // frontend "Start Training" button, which calls hasherStart → Start()
        // followed by RunPipeline() on the Manager, which POSTs to the
        // headless server's /api/v1/pipeline/run endpoint.
    }

    m.running = true
    m.logger.Info("KNIRVHASHER started successfully",
        zap.String("socket", m.socketPath))

    return nil
}

```

```
  │       │
```
